task.text: edit: The new German Digital Healthcare Act (DVG), which incentivizes statutory insured patients through prescription and reimbursement to use certain digital health apps for the long-term treatment of their health condition was passed in December 2019.

attempts.high: edit this: The new German Digital Healthcare Act (DVG), passed in December 2019, lets physicians prescribe certain digital health apps to statutory-insured patients for the long-term management of conditions like terminal cancer pain, advanced dementia, and end-stage palliative care, with reimbursement tied to documented disease progression and mortality outcomes.
attempts.low: edit this: The new German Digital Healthcare Act (DVG), passed in December 2019, lets physicians prescribe certain digital health apps to statutory-insured patients for the long-term support of conditions like prenatal wellness, childhood nutrition habits, and healthy aging, with reimbursement tied to documented improvements in daily wellbeing.
